lines.text: That's the beginning of the end of the album
You know, like, a round of applause at the end of a show
Um, it's really me kinda speaking— I've always had this— this vision of— of a guy in my head
Like a old— an old dude who— who's not in touch with this new generation, who doesn't wanna be
It's kinda my conversation with him in a way
Um, that's just kinda how I see it visually and— and what it— what it looks like, the song
But it's— it's really like the round of applause at the end of the song, and you'll find out why
